name: gizza-ai/encrypt-file
summary: Encrypt or decrypt a file with a passphrase (AES-256-GCM).

tool.description: Encrypt a file with a passphrase using AES-256-GCM (key derived via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256), producing a portable encrypted blob; or decrypt a blob this tool produced. Set mode='encrypt' (default) or 'decrypt' and provide the passphrase. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

mode.description: Whether to encrypt the file (default) or decrypt a blob produced by this tool.

passphrase.description: The passphrase. The same passphrase is required to decrypt.
